digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. V, App. VI

teaser.en: Its thorns are the Digo tool for picking the kernel out of a marula nut.
teaser.sw: Miiba yake ndiyo chombo cha Wadigo cha kutolea kiini ndani ya kokwa la mng'ong'o.
teaser.dg: Adigo anahumira miyaye kutsokola chitsa kula ndani ya *ng’ongo*, tembe ngumu ya tunda ra *Mng’ongo*.

summary.en: Mtsokola ng’ongo is a spiny shrub whose name means 'extractor of the marula nut'. Pakia's appendices disagree on whether the name belongs to Maytenus heterophylla or to Rytigynia celastroides.
summary.sw: Mtsokola ng’ongo ni kichaka chenye miiba ambacho jina lake lina maana ya 'mtoaji wa kokwa la mng'ong'o'. Viambatisho vya Pakia vinatofautiana kuhusu kama jina hili ni la Maytenus heterophylla au la Rytigynia celastroides.
summary.dg: *Mtsokola ng’ongo* ni chitsaka cha miya, ambacho dzinare rina mana ya 'anayetsokola *ng’ongo*'. Nyongeza za Pakia tazilengana kuhusu dzina hiri: kala ni ra *Maytenus heterophylla* au ra *Rytigynia celastroides*.

about.en: Maytenus heterophylla, the spike thorn, is a much-branched shrub or small tree armed with straight spines, often bearing leaves or flowers on them. The leaves are small, leathery and finely toothed, clustered on short side shoots. It bears masses of small white, unpleasant-smelling flowers and small capsules that split to show seeds with an orange-red aril.
about.sw: Maytenus heterophylla, *spike thorn*, ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye matawi mengi, uliojihami kwa miiba iliyonyooka, ambayo mara nyingi huzaa majani au maua juu yake. Majani ni madogo, magumu kama ngozi na yenye meno madogo, yamesongamana kwenye vichipukizi vifupi vya pembeni. Huzaa maua mengi madogo meupe yenye harufu isiyopendeza, na vifuko vidogo vinavyopasuka kuonyesha mbegu zenye ganda-nyama la rangi ya chungwa-nyekundu.
about.dg: *Maytenus heterophylla*, *spike thorn*, ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye panda nyinji na miya ya kugoloka, ambayo mara nyinji ina makodza au maruwa dzuluye. Makodzage ni madide, mafu dza chingo na genye meno madide kanda-kanda, na ganamera mafungu kpwenye maphungo mafupi ga kanda-kanda. Unalavya maruwa madide mereru manji sana, genye arufu mbii, na makakaya madide ganagoahuka kuonyesa tembe zenye gada ra nyama ra kundu na rangi ya chungbwa (*aril*).

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, thicket and wooded grassland.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, vichaka-mwitu vizito na nyika zenye miti.
where.dg: Unamera weruni mwa tsi kavu, vitsakani na nyasini phenye mihi.

uses.en: Pakia records that the thorns are used to extract the kernel from inside the nut of the marula fruit (Sclerocarya birrea, Mng’ongo), which is otherwise hard to reach.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba miiba yake hutumika kutolea kiini kilicho ndani ya kokwa la tunda la mng'ong'o (Sclerocarya birrea, Mng’ongo), ambacho vinginevyo ni vigumu kukifikia.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala miyaye nkuhumirwa kutsokola chitsa kula ndani ya *ng’ongo*, tembe ngumu ya tunda ra *Mng’ongo* (*Sclerocarya birrea*); bila ya miya hino, chitsa hicho ni chigumu kuchiphaha.

culture.en: The name records a small piece of everyday food knowledge: ng’ongo is the hard nut inside the marula fruit, and tsokola means to extract or poke out.
culture.sw: Jina hili linahifadhi kipande kidogo cha maarifa ya kila siku kuhusu chakula: ng’ongo ni kokwa gumu lililo ndani ya tunda la mng'ong'o, na tsokola maana yake ni kutoa au kuchokoa.
culture.dg: Dzina hiri rinaonyesa chitu chidide atu anachochimanya chila siku kuhusu vyakurya: *ng’ongo* ni tembe ngumu iriyo ndani ya tunda ra *mng’ongo*, na *tsokola* ni kutuluza chitu kula ndani.

names.en: Pakia's Appendix III gives Mtsokola ng’ongo for Maytenus heterophylla, explained in Appendix VI as 'extractor of Sclerocarya fruit', from tsokola (to extract) and ng’ongo (the marula nut). Mgombato agrees that tsokola means to poke or pick out with a stick. However, Appendices V and VI give this name to Rytigynia celastroides and call Maytenus heterophylla Mtsokola wongo instead. In English Maytenus heterophylla is the common spike thorn.
names.sw: Kiambatisho III cha Pakia kinatoa Mtsokola ng’ongo kwa Maytenus heterophylla, na Kiambatisho VI kinalifafanua kuwa 'mtoaji wa tunda la Sclerocarya', kutoka tsokola (kutoa) na ng’ongo (kokwa la mng'ong'o). Mgombato inakubali kwamba tsokola maana yake ni kuchokoa au kutoa kwa kijiti. Hata hivyo, Viambatisho V na VI vinalipa jina hili Rytigynia celastroides na kuiita Maytenus heterophylla Mtsokola wongo badala yake. Kwa Kiingereza Maytenus heterophylla inaitwa *common spike thorn*.
names.dg: Nyongeza III ya Pakia inapha *Mtsokola ng’ongo* kpwa *Maytenus heterophylla*, na Nyongeza VI inaeleza dzina hiri kukala ni 'anayetsokola tunda ra *Sclerocarya*', kula *tsokola* (kutuluza) na *ng’ongo* (tembe ya *mng’ongo*). Mgombato nao unagomba kukala *tsokola* ni kutuluza chitu kula kobo kpwa chigongo. Ela Nyongeza V na VI zinapha dzina hiri *Rytigynia celastroides*, na *Maytenus heterophylla* zinauiha *Mtsokola wongo*. Kpwa Chingereza *Maytenus heterophylla* ni *common spike thorn*.

reason.en: Marula, whose nut the thorns extract
reason.sw: Mng'ong'o, ambao kokwa lake hutolewa kwa miiba hii
reason.dg: *Mng’ongo*, ambao miya hino inatsokola chitsa cha ng’ongoze

reason.en: The paired name; the two are swapped between appendices
reason.sw: Jina pacha; majina haya mawili yamebadilishana kati ya viambatisho
reason.dg: Dzina myawe; nyongeza za Pakia zinagabadilisha madzina higa mairi

reason.sw: Kichaka kingine chenye miiba cha porini
reason.dg: Chitsaka chanjina cha miya cha weruni
